title: Distinguished Mayer–Vietoris triangle from extension by zero
statement: Let (X, O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let X = U union V be a cover by open subspaces, and let D(O_X) denote the derived category of sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For E in D(O_X), write j_U, j_V, and j_{UV} for the open inclusions and j_! for exact extension by zero [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. There is a distinguished triangle j_{UV,!}(E restricted to U intersection V) \to j_{U,!}(E restricted to U) direct-sum j_{V,!}(E restricted to V) \to E \to j_{UV,!}(E restricted to U intersection V)[1], whose first map is the difference of the two extension-by-zero restriction maps and whose second map is the pair of counits.
